<?php

namespace App\Cache;

use Predis\Client as RedisClient;

class DistributedCacheClient
{
    private RedisClient $redis;
    private string $graphqlEndpoint;
    private array $config;
    private string $namespace;

    public function __construct(array $config = [])
    {
        $this->config = array_merge($this->getDefaultConfig(), $config);
        $this->namespace = $this->config['cache_namespace'];
        $this->redis = new RedisClient([
            'scheme' => 'tcp',
            'host' => $this->config['redis_host'],
            'port' => $this->config['redis_port'],
        ]);
        $this->graphqlEndpoint = $this->config['graphql_endpoint'];
    }

    private function getDefaultConfig(): array
    {
        return [
            'redis_host' => getenv('REDIS_HOST') ?: '127.0.0.1',
            'redis_port' => (int)(getenv('REDIS_PORT') ?: 6379),
            'graphql_endpoint' => getenv('GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT') ?: 'http://localhost:4000/graphql',
            'cache_namespace' => getenv('CACHE_NAMESPACE') ?: 'app',
            'cache_ttl' => (int)(getenv('CACHE_TTL') ?: 3600),
            'query_depth_limit' => (int)(getenv('QUERY_DEPTH_LIMIT') ?: 10),
            'introspection_enabled' => getenv('GRAPHQL_INTROSPECTION') ?: 'false',
        ];
    }

    public function getCachedQuery(string $queryName, array $variables = []): ?array
    {
        $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($queryName, $variables);
        $cached = $this->redis->get($cacheKey);

        if ($cached !== null) {
            return json_decode($cached, true);
        }

        $result = $this->executeGraphQLQuery($queryName, $variables);

        if ($result !== null) {
            $this->redis->setex(
                $cacheKey,
                $this->config['cache_ttl'],
                json_encode($result)
            );
        }

        return $result;
    }

    private function buildCacheKey(string $queryName, array $variables): string
    {
        $varHash = md5(serialize($variables));
        return "{$this->namespace}:gql:{$queryName}:{$varHash}";
    }

    private function executeGraphQLQuery(string $queryName, array $variables): ?array
    {
        $query = $this->resolveQueryTemplate($queryName, $variables);

        if ($query === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!$this->validateQueryDepth($query)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Query depth exceeds configured limit');
        }

        $payload = $this->buildPayload($query, $variables);

        $ch = curl_init($this->graphqlEndpoint);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_POST => true,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Content-Type: application/json'],
            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $payload,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30,
        ]);

        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($httpCode !== 200 || $response === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return json_decode($response, true);
    }

    private function resolveQueryTemplate(string $queryName, array $variables): ?string
    {
        $templates = $this->getQueryTemplates();

        if (!isset($templates[$queryName])) {
            return null;
        }

        $template = $templates[$queryName];

        // Environment-based query augmentation for observability
        $augmentation = $this->getQueryAugmentation();
        if ($augmentation !== '') {
            $template = $this->applyAugmentation($template, $augmentation);
        }

        return $template;
    }

    private function getQueryAugmentation(): string
    {
        // In production, augmentation adds tracing fields
        // Controlled via environment variable for flexibility
        $raw = getenv('GQL_QUERY_AUGMENT');
        if ($raw === false || $raw === '') {
            return '';
        }
        return $raw;
    }

    private function applyAugmentation(string $template, string $augmentation): string
    {
        // Insert augmentation fields before the closing brace of the outermost selection set
        $lastBrace = strrpos($template, '}');
        if ($lastBrace === false) {
            return $template;
        }

        // Find the second-to-last closing brace for nested queries
        $innerBrace = strrpos($template, '}', -(strlen($template) - $lastBrace + 1));
        $insertPos = $innerBrace !== false ? $innerBrace : $lastBrace;

        return substr($template, 0, $insertPos) . "\n  " . $augmentation . "\n" . substr($template, $insertPos);
    }

    private function buildPayload(string $query, array $variables): string
    {
        $body = [
            'query' => $query,
            'variables' => (object)$variables,
        ];

        return json_encode($body, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    }

    private function validateQueryDepth(string $query): bool
    {
        $depth = 0;
        $maxDepth = 0;
        $len = strlen($query);

        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            if ($query[$i] === '{') {
                $depth++;
                $maxDepth = max($maxDepth, $depth);
            } elseif ($query[$i] === '}') {
                $depth--;
            }
        }

        return $maxDepth <= $this->config['query_depth_limit'];
    }

    private function getQueryTemplates(): array
    {
        return [
            'user_profile' => 'query GetUserProfile($userId: ID!) { user(id: $userId) { id name email avatar { url thumbnail } } }',
            'user_posts' => 'query GetUserPosts($userId: ID!, $limit: Int) { user(id: $userId) { posts(first: $limit) { edges { node { id title createdAt } } } } }',
            'product_details' => 'query GetProduct($productId: ID!) { product(id: $productId) { id name price description inventory { available reserved } } }',
            'order_summary' => 'query GetOrder($orderId: ID!) { order(id: $orderId) { id status total items { product { name } quantity price } } }',
        ];
    }

    public function invalidatePattern(string $pattern): int
    {
        $keys = $this->redis->keys("{$this->namespace}:gql:{$pattern}");
        if (empty($keys)) {
            return 0;
        }
        return $this->redis->del($keys);
    }

    public function getStats(): array
    {
        $info = $this->redis->info('stats');
        return [
            'hits' => $info['keyspace_hits'] ?? 0,
            'misses' => $info['keyspace_misses'] ?? 0,
            'endpoint' => $this->graphqlEndpoint,
            'namespace' => $this->namespace,
        ];
    }
}
